newsitem.title: CANADA: Manitoba harvest 85 percent complete by Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: Manitoba harvest 85 percent complete by Oct 15.

text.p: Sunny weather allowed harvest to advance to 85 percent complete in the week ended October 15 with yields expected to be average or above average, Manitoba Agriculture said in its weekly crop report.

Southwest Manitoba - Sunny weather allowed harvest to progress. Heavy rain and hail around Minnedosa Monday will delay combining for a week. Overall, harvest was 90 to 95 percent complete while Minnedosa was 75 percent complete.
Northwest Manitoba - Combining was about 80 percent complete in wheat with yields averaging 35 bushels an acre. Canola was 95 percent done. Monday's rain dropped 10-20 mm.
Central Manitoba - Combining was 85 to 90 percent complete. Wheat and barley yields were above average and quality was very good.

Eastern Manitoba - Harvest was all but complete with only a small number of late seeded fields left to combine. Red spring wheat yields averaged at 40 bushel per acre, barley 75 bu/ac, oats 85 bu/ac and canola was 35 bu/ac.
Interlake region - Harvest was 95 percent complete.
